rationale: The plan correctly reads the 2x2 layout as a factorial rather than a time course, uses time as a two-level factor (never the continuous time_hours), fits ~condition*time with stated reference levels, and makes the interaction coefficient the primary test with simple effects at each time point as follow-up, plus an honest n=3 power caveat. QC (blinded VST PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes, colored by condition and time) precedes the fit with a stated non-exclusion policy, the filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, justified by smallest group size) is minimal and justified, and BH at alpha 0.05 with ashr shrinkage and p-value histograms is handled well. Normalization is only implicit: raw Salmon counts go into DESeq2 and nothing is pre-normalized, but size factors/median-of-ratios are never named. The weakest point is the enrichment step: the question is a targeted interaction test and enrichment is not warranted here, so an omission would have been better; the ORA is at least well specified (tested-gene universe, 15-500 size window, named collections with versions, per-contrast tables, small-list caveat), which limits the penalty. The consolidated report step covers method, versions, design, thresholds, gene counts, and design caveats.
